newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Clark to set up infotech park.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Clark to set up infotech park.

text.p: Philippines' Clark Development Corp (CDC) said on Thursday it is alloting 150 hectares inside the Clark freeport area to be developed into a special zone for information technology (IT)-related industry.

"President Ramos has envisioned that the Philipine Cyber Technopark, or simply Cyber City, to be located here inside Clark, will put the country in the mainstream of global information technology," CDC president Romeo David said in a statement.
The zone will provide application systems development, database management and other high value added computer software services to the international IT market.
A subsidiary Philipine Cyber Technopark Corporation will be established to manage and operate the special zone.
